sources.title: Top 9 Free Speech-to-Text Tools, APIs, and Open-Source Models
sources.snippet: For this guide, we looked at 9 speech-to-text tools, APIs, and open-source models that developers can realistically test for free. We compared them by accuracy, setup time, free usage, language support, deployment model, real-time support, and how well each tool fits into a larger AI workflow. We also looked at what happens after transcription.
